notes.title: September 15th Patch
notes.notes:
In Pedro Land DX, the little tutorial clouds present in a couple of the modes have been removed, since they don't match the new controls.
In Pedro Lost Tales, some text for letting players know about the museum lock has been fixed.
In the Pedro Deep Delve mode, I had forgotten that the treasure that I thought was missing was actually in some crates in one of the rooms. That has been fixed. The treasure's current hiding place is in one of the earlier rooms.

I hope you all will still enjoy this game.
 - Jared, main developer of Pedro Land DX and Pedro Lost Tales

A secret cutscene was also added for those who will find every treasure!

notes.title: August 23rd Patch
notes.notes: In Pedro Lost Levels, some areas had impossible ladder jumps. Those have been fixed.

notes.title: August 22nd Patch - NEW FREE EXPANSION: Pedro Lost Tales (This is also a test)
notes.notes:
Let's get some stuff out of the way first...
In Pedro Land DX, when playing using a keyboard, Jump has been mapped to "K", and Shoot has been mapped to "J", to be consistent with how most platformers use those keys.

Now onto the bigger stuff...
We have decided to add in a game that was meant to be a sequel to Pedro Land DX, Pedro Lost Tales.
This free expansion has several new campaigns to conquer!

I have never tacked one game onto another before, so if there are bugs or game-crashing glitches, I will seek to (hopefully) fix them post-launch.
We hope this new expansion will make you players smile. :)

- Jared, main developer of Pedro Land DX and Pedro Lost Tales

notes.title: September Recent Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
In some recent updates I didn't specify what bugs were fixed, so here's the rundown:

Fixed some npc and player interactions.
Fixed a missing collision with an enemy for Pedro.
Fixed an issue where there was no player in  a Pedro Land 2 level.

I apologize for these small issues. 
I hope ya'll continue to enjoy the game!
-Jared

notes.title: September 21st Udpate
notes.notes:
Rush's paintballs shouldn't crash the game now.

NEW character interactions!
Miguel, Rush, and Shamel now appear in cutscenes when playable. 
If Miguel is being played, Pedro will act as the NPC this time around.
If Rush is playable, Pedro will also act as an NPC.
Play through all the campaigns to see how people react to the characters now!

notes.title: Pedro Land DX Patch Update: 2nd Anniversary Edition
notes.notes:
It's already been TWO years since Pedro Land DX dropped on Steam!

Here's what this update includes:

Added an on/off toggle for music and sfx in the options menu.
Fixed some player collisions with walls and semisolid surfaces.
Added completion icons that show up when the player beats a mode with Pedro's knight form, Miguel, Rush, and Shamel.
Some other minor fixes with sounds, text, and other things.

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Pedro Land DX: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Pedro Land DX has been out for over a year now, but I though the game needed a little more spice, so I made some fixes to the game's inner workings, as well as some extra things.
Pedro and friends have been given a visual update again, to closer resemble artwork, but may also lead to more expressions.
The playable characters' run physics have also been updated. Now you can skid across the floor like an old-school platformer mascot!
In the options you can now use the SOUNDTRACK SWAPPER! With this new feature, you can hear some older, unused versions of the Pedro Land and Pedro Land 2 soundtracks.
I hope you all have enjoyed Pedro Land DX, and Merry Christmas!

-Jared, creator of Pedro Land DX

notes.title: Pedro Land DX: Final Fiesta: A Farewell to Amigos
notes.notes:
The last major update for Pedro Land DX is finally here!
Here's what it adds:

GUNMAN CASTLE: 
In this final chapter of the game, Pedro investigates a mysterious fortress that appeared on the horizon.

NEW LORE GALLERY:
An extra room was added in the secret museum, and it contains extra lore for the well-read players.
A few extra enemies were also added to the existing galleries.

CHARACTER SWAP:
Found in the Options menu is the new Character Swap!
You can now play as Miguel, Rush, or Shamel. These characters have their own playstyles!
They function like Pedro when he has the Holy Gun, so expect to always go to the Character Swap when you want to select another character.
Can you beat all of the story modes with 'em?

ACHIEVEMENTS: 
Of course, a big update like this wouldn't be complete without some new achievements.

small CHANGES:
A few minor changes were added:

A small change to how new players will earn the Bad Ending achievement for Pedro Land 2. Now you can earn it separately from the Good Ending achievement.

A Fire Pepper was added to the first room of Taco Tower.

A church was added to the Amigo Port village in PL2 and PL3, for some extra worldbuilding.

We hope you players will enjoy these new additions to the game.

HAVE FUN, 

Jared, creator of Pedro Land DX.

notes.title: Pedro Land DX is Coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
That's right! The action run-and-gun western is coming to Steam!

Pedro Land DX is a mini compilation of two games, Taco Tower and Pedro Land!

Taco Tower sees the protagonist Pedro as he sets out to reclaim the titular spire from the beasts that roam his homeland, Doon.

Pedro Land continues Pedro's quest to fight back against the beasts and save his home.

The games aim to replicate an old-school 80s style found in platformers of that era!
